about.cta.zh: 原作展示於淡水黑客茶舖。
about.cta.en: The original paintings hang at Hacha in Tamsui.

about.practice.zh: 他向心中最好的畫家學習，米羅、畢卡索、康丁斯基都在其中，再把學到的化成自己的語言。
about.practice.en: He learns from the painters he thinks are the best, Miró, Picasso and Kandinsky among them, and turns what he learns into a language of his own.

about.quote.en: I always go for the best.

about.statement.zh: 張忠晉生於高雄，年輕時北上台北打拼，後來到淡水開餐廳。等待新店裝潢的那段日子，他拿起畫筆，想為自己的店畫幾幅畫，從此沒有停下。他完全自學，畫過素描、壓克力，現在以油畫為主。一個為生活工作的生意人，透過繪畫抒發自己。
about.statement.en: Achin was born in Kaohsiung and moved north to Taipei as a young man to make his way. Later he opened a restaurant in Tamsui. While he waited for it to be fitted out, he began painting to decorate its walls, and he never stopped. He is self-taught. He has worked in pencil and acrylic, and today he paints mostly in oil. A businessman who works for a living and paints to express himself.

contact.headline.en: Come to Tamsui and see the originals.

contact.intro.zh: 張忠晉的原作展示於他在淡水經營的餐廳黑客茶舖。營業時間內歡迎來看畫。收藏、委託或合作，歡迎洽詢；價格請洽詢。
contact.intro.en: Achin's original paintings hang at Hacha, the restaurant he runs in Tamsui. Drop in during opening hours to see them. For purchases, commissions or collaborations, please ask. Prices on request.

gallery.note.en: Most of the originals hang at Hacha in Tamsui.

home.headline.zh: 人生來就是要享受人生的。
home.headline.en: We are born to enjoy life.

home.hero_deck.zh: 淡水的生意人，自學的畫家。手、梯子、十字與面孔，在他的畫裡一再出現。
home.hero_deck.en: A Tamsui businessman and a self-taught painter. Hands, ladders, crosses and faces return again and again in his work.
